package.name: amr_costmap_plugins
package.description: Nav2 costmap_2d layer plugins. RampCostLayer turns slope into traversability cost for the global planner; FleetTrajectoryLayer stamps the other robots' predicted trajectories into each robot's local costmap, which is where the MAPF requirement is satisfied. C++ because both run at costmap update rate behind the pluginlib API. SKELETON: RampCostLayer lands in Phase 4, FleetTrajectoryLayer in Phase 6.
